scenes.heading: SQL
scenes.caption: SQL is the language you use to ask a relational database for rows, or to change them. A table is rows and columns. A query says which rows and which columns you want. Most business data lives in tables. Being able to read a query is a job skill even for people who do not call themselves database engineers.
